answer: A maritime agent economy resists Sybil attacks using kinematic proofs tied to coastal infrastructure. To join, an autonomous vessel logs an acoustic handshake at a harbor jetty, binding its cryptographic key to verified hydrodynamic propulsion data. An attacker cannot forge identities without purchasing and fueling discrete physical hulls. However, magnetic distortion from a sunken iron relic can corrupt compass telemetry, spuriously rejecting honest agents.
